sources.title: Roofline Performance Model
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CUDA：執行格、區塊與邊界守衛
related.titleEn: CUDA: grids, blocks and bounds guards
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付Roofline點位、算術/流量帳及瓶頸假說；400/1600及I10交點正確，所有量層級一致並標明上限；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver Roofline points, arithmetic/traffic accounting and bottleneck hypotheses. Verify 400/1600 and I 10 with consistent levels and explicit bound labels. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 推導i=blockIdx×blockDim+threadIdx，畫最後區塊有效與無效lane；4/8可重算，所有1000輸出正確且額外槽不修改資料。
related.differenceEn: Derive i = blockIdx × blockDim + threadIdx. Mark valid and invalid lanes in the last block. Reproduce 4/8 with 1000 correct outputs and no writes from extra slots.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Pbound=min(Ppeak,I×B)，I=FLOP/byte；對同一記憶體層級定義B和流量；合成Ppeak=2000GFLOP/s、B=200GB/s，I2對8，十進位單位；名義式 2*200 = 400 GFLOP/s bound；變更式 8*200 = 1600 GFLOP/s bound。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
grid=ceil(N/block)，總啟動槽grid×block；僅i<N的執行緒可寫輸出；合成N1000，block256對128，核函數每有效索引寫i²；名義式 ceil(1000/256) = 4 blocks；變更式 ceil(1000/128) = 8 blocks。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Pbound=min(Ppeak, I×B), with I in FLOP/byte and matching memory level for B/traffic. Synthetic Ppeak 2000 GFLOP/s, B 200 GB/s, I 2 versus 8, decimal units. Nominal 2*200 = 400 GFLOP/s bound; changed 8*200 = 1600 GFLOP/s bound. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

grid=ceil(N/block), launched slots=grid×block; only i<N may write outputs. Synthetic N 1000, block 256 versus 128; each valid index writes i². Nominal ceil(1000/256) = 4 blocks; changed ceil(1000/128) = 8 blocks. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PETSc CG：殘差、誤差與停止條件
related.titleEn: PETSc CG: residuals, errors and stopping criteria
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付Roofline點位、算術/流量帳及瓶頸假說；400/1600及I10交點正確，所有量層級一致並標明上限；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver Roofline points, arithmetic/traffic accounting and bottleneck hypotheses. Verify 400/1600 and I 10 with consistent levels and explicit bound labels. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列Ax、r=b−Ax和精確解[1,1]，分別畫殘差與解誤差兩欄；兩比值正確，第一案不過.01、第二案通過；明示這是教學門檻。
related.differenceEn: List Ax, r = b − Ax, and the exact solution [1, 1]. Keep residual and solution-error columns separate. Both ratios match; first fails 0.01, second passes, and the threshold is labeled instructional.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Pbound=min(Ppeak,I×B)，I=FLOP/byte；對同一記憶體層級定義B和流量；合成Ppeak=2000GFLOP/s、B=200GB/s，I2對8，十進位單位；名義式 2*200 = 400 GFLOP/s bound；變更式 8*200 = 1600 GFLOP/s bound。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

相對殘差ρ=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂；CG另需適合的對稱正定問題，不能忽略矩陣條件；合成A=diag(2,4)，b=[2,4]，x=[.9,1]；變更x=[.99,1]；名義式 .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual；變更式 .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Pbound=min(Ppeak, I×B), with I in FLOP/byte and matching memory level for B/traffic. Synthetic Ppeak 2000 GFLOP/s, B 200 GB/s, I 2 versus 8, decimal units. Nominal 2*200 = 400 GFLOP/s bound; changed 8*200 = 1600 GFLOP/s bound. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Relative residual rho=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂; CG also requires suitable symmetric-positive-definite systems. Synthetic A=diag(2, 4), b [2, 4], x [.9, 1] then [.99, 1]. Nominal .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual; changed .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
